```{r}
# library(devtools)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(qiime2R)
})
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Project paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

project_dir <- "/data/home2/ksy/260724_GutMyco_Fungal_Mock_Paper"
rproj_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "Rproj")

run_id <- "fig4_q20_PE_itsxpress_unite"

run_dir <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  "Output",
  run_id
)

metadata_path <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  "Input",
  "metadata_mock_stool_and_mock_260724.tsv"
)
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. ITSdetector result paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

paths <- list(
  run_dir = run_dir,

  # DADA2 outputs
  table_qza = file.path(
    run_dir,
    "dada2", "itsxpress", "paired",
    "table.qza"
  ),

  repseq_qza = file.path(
    run_dir,
    "dada2", "itsxpress", "paired",
    "repseq.qza"
  ),

  denoising_stats_qza = file.path(
    run_dir,
    "dada2", "itsxpress", "paired",
    "denoising_stats.qza"
  ),

  # UNITE taxonomy
  taxonomy_unite_tsv = file.path(
    run_dir,
    "taxonomy", "itsxpress", "paired", "unite_ver10_99",
    "taxonomy.tsv"
  ),

  taxonomy_unite_qza = file.path(
    run_dir,
    "taxonomy", "itsxpress", "paired", "unite_ver10_99",
    "taxonomy.qza"
  ),

  # BLAST-refined taxonomy
  taxonomy_blast_tsv = file.path(
    run_dir,
    "taxonomy_blast", "itsxpress", "paired", "unite_ver10_99",
    "taxonomy_blast.tsv"
  ),

  blast_evidence_tsv = file.path(
    run_dir,
    "taxonomy_blast", "itsxpress", "paired", "unite_ver10_99",
    "taxonomy_blast_evidence.tsv"
  ),

  blast_report_tsv = file.path(
    run_dir,
    "taxonomy_blast", "itsxpress", "paired", "unite_ver10_99",
    "taxonomy_blast_report.tsv"
  ),

  blast_candidates_top5_tsv = file.path(
    run_dir,
    "taxonomy_blast", "itsxpress", "paired", "unite_ver10_99",
    "blast_candidates_top5.tsv"
  ),

  # Metadata / QC
  sample_metadata = metadata_path,

  samplesheet_validated = file.path(
    run_dir,
    "input_validation",
    "samplesheet.validated.csv"
  ),

  cleanup_qc_summary = file.path(
    run_dir,
    "cleanup_qc",
    "cleanup_qc_summary.tsv"
  ),

  qiime_manifest_pe = file.path(
    run_dir,
    "qiime_manifest",
    "qiime_manifest_pe.tsv"
  ),

  qiime_manifest_r1 = file.path(
    run_dir,
    "qiime_manifest",
    "qiime_manifest_r1.tsv"
  )
)
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Check file existence
# ------------------------------------------------------------

check_paths <- tibble(
  file_key = names(paths),
  path = unlist(paths),
  exists = file.exists(unlist(paths))
)

print(check_paths)

missing_files <- check_paths %>%
  filter(!exists)

if (nrow(missing_files) > 0) {
  warning(
    "Some files are missing:\n",
    paste(missing_files$path, collapse = "\n")
  )
}
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Load QIIME2 artifacts
# ------------------------------------------------------------

feature_table_qza <- read_qza(paths$table_qza)
repseq_qza <- read_qza(paths$repseq_qza)

feature_table <- feature_table_qza$data
repseq <- repseq_qza$data

# Denoising stats may or may not be needed later
denoising_stats <- NULL
if (file.exists(paths$denoising_stats_qza)) {
  denoising_stats <- read_qza(paths$denoising_stats_qza)$data
}
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Load taxonomy tables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

taxonomy_unite <- read_tsv(
  paths$taxonomy_unite_tsv,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

taxonomy_blast <- NULL
if (file.exists(paths$taxonomy_blast_tsv)) {
  taxonomy_blast <- read_tsv(
    paths$taxonomy_blast_tsv,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}

blast_evidence <- NULL
if (file.exists(paths$blast_evidence_tsv)) {
  blast_evidence <- read_tsv(
    paths$blast_evidence_tsv,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}

blast_report <- NULL
if (file.exists(paths$blast_report_tsv)) {
  blast_report <- read_tsv(
    paths$blast_report_tsv,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}

blast_candidates_top5 <- NULL
if (file.exists(paths$blast_candidates_top5_tsv)) {
  blast_candidates_top5 <- read_tsv(
    paths$blast_candidates_top5_tsv,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Load metadata and run-level files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sample_metadata <- read_tsv(
  paths$sample_metadata,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

samplesheet_validated <- read_csv(
  paths$samplesheet_validated,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

cleanup_qc_summary <- read_tsv(
  paths$cleanup_qc_summary,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

qiime_manifest_pe <- read_tsv(
  paths$qiime_manifest_pe,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

qiime_manifest_r1 <- read_tsv(
  paths$qiime_manifest_r1,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Run annotation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

run_info <- tibble(
  run_id = run_id,
  pipeline = "ITSdetector",
  preprocess_method = "itsxpress",
  read_strategy = "paired",
  qc_profile = "Q20",
  taxonomy_reference = "UNITE v10 99",
  unite_available = file.exists(paths$taxonomy_unite_tsv),
  blast_available = file.exists(paths$taxonomy_blast_tsv)
)

print(run_info)
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Loaded objects summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------

loaded_objects <- tibble(
  object_name = c(
    "feature_table",
    "repseq",
    "denoising_stats",
    "taxonomy_unite",
    "taxonomy_blast",
    "blast_evidence",
    "blast_report",
    "blast_candidates_top5",
    "sample_metadata",
    "samplesheet_validated",
    "cleanup_qc_summary",
    "qiime_manifest_pe",
    "qiime_manifest_r1",
    "run_info"
  ),
  loaded = c(
    exists("feature_table"),
    exists("repseq"),
    !is.null(denoising_stats),
    exists("taxonomy_unite"),
    !is.null(taxonomy_blast),
    !is.null(blast_evidence),
    !is.null(blast_report),
    !is.null(blast_candidates_top5),
    exists("sample_metadata"),
    exists("samplesheet_validated"),
    exists("cleanup_qc_summary"),
    exists("qiime_manifest_pe"),
    exists("qiime_manifest_r1"),
    exists("run_info")
  )
)

print(loaded_objects)

```
